issues.message: index.js login() calls console.log("PASSWORD:", password), logging the plaintext password to stdout/CI logs. This is a credential-exposure security issue — an attacker or anyone with log access could recover user passwords. The surrounding change only adds blank lines and comments, leaving this exposed rather than removing it.
